title: Headcount: a Claude Code setup where agents are split by which files they own, not by topic

sections.title: Transcript
paragraphs: Headcount turns clawed code into an org chart instead of one prompt. It ships 16 departments and 143 skills, engineering to legal, and each installs as its own plug-in. So a project loads only what it needs. Agents split by exclusive right surfaces, what they own, not by topic. So two agents can't quietly step on the same file.
